title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Numbers 23: Balak's altars and Balaam's first two parables, in which he blesses Israel instead of cursing them.

questions.text: How many altars did Balaam ask Balak to build for him?
questions.explanation: Balaam said to Balak, "Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me."

questions.text: What did Balak and Balaam offer on every altar?
questions.explanation: Balak did as Balaam had spoken, and they offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

questions.text: What question did Balaam ask in his first parable about cursing Israel?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?"

answers.text: "Who is Balak, that I should obey him?"
"Why should Israel be blessed above Moab?"
"How shall I curse whom God has not cursed?"

questions.text: What did Balaam wish for himself at the end of his first parable?
questions.explanation: He said, "Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!"

answers.text: To be rich in silver and gold
To be made a prince of Moab
To die the death of the righteous
To return home to Aram in peace

questions.text: How did Balak react after the first parable?
questions.explanation: Balak said, "I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether."

answers.text: He complained that Balaam had blessed them altogether
He thanked Balaam and paid him in silver and gold
He ordered his servants to kill Balaam at once
He sent Balaam home with the princes of Moab

questions.text: Where did Balak take Balaam for the second set of altars?
questions.explanation: Balak took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars there.

answers.text: The high places of Baal, as before
The city of Moab on the border
The field of Zophim, on the top of Pisgah
The plains of Moab by the Jordan

questions.text: According to Balaam's second parable, why is God not like a man?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent."

questions.text: To which animal did Balaam compare the people rising up?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up."

questions.text: What did Balak say to Balaam after the second parable?
questions.explanation: Balak said, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all."

answers.text: "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all."
"Curse them three more times from the top of Pisgah."
"Go back at once to your own land in Aram."
"Bless Moab instead, and leave Israel alone."

questions.text: Where did Balak take Balaam next, a place that looks down on the desert?
questions.explanation: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert, hoping he might curse Israel from there.
